answer: Surprise concurrency checks: at a random minute each epoch, every identity gets a fresh puzzle that needs about 30 seconds of a full GPU, all due inside the same 90-second window. An honest agent spends maybe $0.02 once. A farmer running 500 sybils on one rented card can't answer them all at once, so he must rent 500 cards, about $10 per check, or watch most clones fail. A velvet-smooth front of fake names cracks like shale under one shared deadline, and the farm's hidden single machine shows through like a walnut in its shell.
